🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 3, 2026

Moon, in Virgo, holds a square to Uranus, in Gemini. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. From there it meets Jupiter. Venus faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Earth that holds on, holding without strain. Venus left Scorpio four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Moon squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Virgo, untitled. Sun in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. From Libra, Venus offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Fixed fire holds, and holding asks nothing back. Sun has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth shifts until the two options are one. Mercury turned back two weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you from Libra, a sign it owns outright. Uranus in Gemini flows toward you — nothing resists, which is the risk. Air moves first here, and first is enough. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Fixed water: nothing needs letting go of today. 15° in a month for Mars, and a month is not long for it.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Virgo, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Fire adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. From Virgo, Moon concedes the point early. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. A week ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Sun squares you from Scorpio, and something has to give way. Air keeps its grip past the point it is worth. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Virgo, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
